items.contract: The administrator stages recurring teacher or room unavailability, inspects direct effects and policy state, applies individual or confirmed bulk pins, and leaves one durable conflict-free repair draft ready to solve.
rules: RULE-15 requires a separate intent overlay.
RULE-16 requires immutable direct-effect and bulk snapshots.
items.actorBoundary: Real Chrome and real HTTP over PostgreSQL 18.6
items.claim: Both resource journeys, direct effects, individual and bulk pins, conflict feedback, summary, and durable ready state are implemented end to end.

evidence.observation: HTTP assertions compare exact staged changes, effects, pins, revisions and accepted bundle; Chrome performs staging, keyboard pinning, conflict resolution, bulk confirmation/undo and discard.

negativeObligations: Accepted definition and result are not mutated
No conflict-free readiness is shown while a conflict exists

items.contract: Unsupported class unavailability, cancellation, required move, or teacher reassignment stages nothing and explains the boundary.
rules: RULE-15 forbids unsupported change types.
items.claim: An unsupported reassignment is refused with a safe stable response and no state change; the UI lists the unsupported actions.

evidence.observation: The test receives 422 INVALID_REPAIR_DRAFT, retains ACCEPTED_BASELINE and compares exact accepted JSON; catalog text names all deferred actions.

negativeObligations: No repair draft or accepted mutation is persisted

items.contract: A staged resource change with no directly affected accepted lesson is retained and explicitly represented by an empty direct-effect set.
rules: RULE-16 calculates effects only from accepted assignments.
items.claim: Unavailability at mon-3 remains staged with an empty direct-effect array and a durable repair draft.

evidence.observation: The test asserts directEffectLessonIds is empty and compares the HTTP repairDraft with a new repository load.

negativeObligations: No accepted lesson is invented as directly affected

items.contract: A pin contradicting staged unavailability or persistent policy is an explicit blocking conflict and no winner is chosen silently.
rules: RULE-16 requires DRAFT_CONFLICT semantics and retained instructions.
items.claim: Attempt and persistent policy conflicts retain both instructions, identify the exact lesson, and block readiness.

evidence.observation: Assertions observe lesson-math-1, PIN_CONTRADICTS_UNAVAILABILITY and readyToSolve false for both attempt and persistent locks.

negativeObligations: No pin or availability instruction is silently removed

items.contract: Cancelling bulk preview applies no pin from the snapshot.
rules: RULE-16 separates preview from confirmation.
items.actorBoundary: Version-sensitive preview HTTP and browser preview
items.claim: Preview is non-mutating; making no confirmation request leaves the pin set empty and the browser supplies a cancel action.

evidence.source: WorkspaceRepairDraftIT.java:152-168 and app.js bulk preview controls
evidence.observation: After a successful preview the repository intent pins array remains empty; cancel changes only browser-local bulkPreview state.

negativeObligations: No preview lesson is pinned before confirmation

items.contract: Undoing a bulk action removes exactly its snapshot except persistent policy locks and independent pins.
rules: RULE-16 requires exact source-scoped undo.
items.actorBoundary: Repair-draft HTTP and PostgreSQL intent document
items.claim: Bulk source removal preserves an independently applied room source and clears only the named bulk action.

evidence.observation: After undo, periodSources is empty, roomSources equals [INDIVIDUAL], and bulkActions is empty.

negativeObligations: Independent pin sources are not removed
Persistent policy locks are not edited

items.contract: Autosave failure warns, preserves accepted state, and prevents solving from an unpersisted intent revision.
rules: RULE-3 and RULE-5 require durable guarded lifecycle mutation.
items.actorBoundary: Injected PostgreSQL failure over real HTTP
items.claim: A failed update returns STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE, rolls back to the exact durable draft and baseline, and run start remains refused.

evidence.observation: A BEFORE UPDATE trigger fails autosave; assertions compare exact pre/post document and receive 409 when POST /api/runs is attempted.

negativeObligations: No unpersisted pin is exposed as durable
No kernel process is started from the repair draft

items.contract: Any remaining conflict identifies the lesson and instructions and prevents solve submission.
rules: RULE-16 makes conflicts blocking.
items.actorBoundary: HTTP draft state and desktop browser
items.claim: Conflict state identifies lesson/resource with visible text and disables later solve readiness until unpinned.

evidence.observation: The server emits the exact conflict and readyToSolve false; Chrome observes Resolve blocking conflicts and then ready state after removal.

negativeObligations: A conflicting draft is not submitted

items.contract: Explicit confirmed discard clears staged intent and attempt pins and returns to accepted baseline.
rules: RULE-5 permits only the repair-draft to accepted-baseline discard edge.
items.claim: Unconfirmed discard is refused; confirmed discard removes repairDraft and preserves exact acceptedBaseline.

evidence.observation: HTTP and Chrome require confirmation, return ACCEPTED_BASELINE, assert repairDraft absent and compare accepted JSON.

negativeObligations: Unconfirmed discard does not mutate state
Accepted baseline is not removed

items.contract: Restart restores autosaved changes and attempt pins as a repair draft without changing accepted baseline.
rules: RULE-3 makes PostgreSQL the durable authority.
items.actorBoundary: PostgreSQL aggregate loaded through repository/startup behavior
items.claim: REPAIR_DRAFT is stored durably and is not one of the transient states rewritten by WorkspaceRecovery.

evidence.observation: A fresh repository load equals the HTTP repairDraft; recovery updates only SOLVING_INITIAL and INITIAL_PROPOSAL, leaving REPAIR_DRAFT stable.

negativeObligations: Restart does not accept the draft
Accepted bundle remains exact

evidence.observation: Assertions compare basedOnRevision, availablePeriodIds, periodLock, roomLock, omitted accepted availability and full acceptedBaseline before/after.

negativeObligations: Accepted assignment JSON is not edited
No substitute or soft-protection weight is created

items.contract: All currently unaffected lessons is the immutable complement at preview time and later edits do not expand it.

items.contract: Draft edits, pins, undo, discard and persistence never change accepted bundle.

items.contract: Pin feedback meets the 250 ms p95 interaction target on the validation-scale fixture.
rules: RULE-25 separates interaction measurement from solver duration.
items.actorBoundary: Real Chrome with ephemeral HTTP and PostgreSQL

evidence.observation: Fixture cardinalities are 1000/100/60/100/60; clean-run nearest-rank p95 was 190.5 ms and the test excludes solver time.

negativeObligations: Solver duration is not included in pin-feedback samples
counterEvidence: A pre-submission full-matrix rerender measured 369.8 ms p95; it was replaced and later focused/full runs passed at 142.2/190.5 ms.
